name: one-arm-kettlebell-bench-press
instructions:
1. Begin in a seated, upright position with the kettlebell handle in one hand and your other free hand supporting the bottom of the bell.
2. Lay back on the bench and press the kettlebell to full extension by contracting the tricep and pec.
3. Lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
